chunks: Ask them: 'Which of you is able to vouch for this?'

key_terms.زَعِيمٌ: Guarantor / Vouchsafed one / One who takes responsibility

ai.seo_question: Who will take responsibility for one's sins on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical challenge underscores the principle of individual accountability (mas'uliyyah) by asking disbelievers to designate a 'guarantor' (zameen) for the punishment, highlighting that no one can bear another's burden. It serves as a critique of those who seek intercession or delegation of divine justice, reinforcing the concept that each soul is responsible for its own faith and deeds. This verse is often cited to illustrate the futility of relying on others for salvation in the Hereafter.
